decisions.reason: The glass flake two-component spraying system extends the firm's core spraying and two-component knowledge, so it can read field feedback and refine the system through its own R&D rather than withdraw it.

The low-pressure injection pump sits very close to the established injection and construction-repair offer and has its own web page, so the firm's existing knowledge makes improvement easy and dropping unlikely.
The multi-model transfer pump line builds directly on the firm's conveying and pump engineering, letting it adjust variants within the line instead of dropping it.

Flow monitoring for fire protection reaches into less familiar sensing territory, but it supports the digitalization goal and university cooperation helps the firm assimilate the needed knowledge, so it keeps the product while learning.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is close to the firm's core spraying expertise and was launched only recently, so absorptive capacity is high and early results can be interpreted and acted on in-house.
